title: On a slow connection, tapping 'Request Introduction' / 'Join Queue' shows nothing for a second or more, because the app re-downloads the advert to check the seller's ID — a check it already made when the page opened.
fix: Cache the first answer on the listing object (l._canReceive) inside openDetail and have openModal open the form immediately, blocking only when the stored answer is explicitly false; add a brief pressed/loading state to the button.
impact: She taps twice or thinks the main button is broken.

title: The home page's 'Featured' section always says 'Featured listings will appear here once sellers are onboarded', even when the square is full of live adverts.
fix: Populate the Featured strip from real listings (e.g. super_example/showcase adverts) or hide the heading and strip entirely when the featured list is empty.
impact: First-time visitors, including everyone arriving from Quick, are told the marketplace has no sellers yet.

title: When her language is isiZulu, Afrikaans etc. (for example carried over from Quick), her first visit sends about 30 translation requests — for the text of every screen, including ones she never opens — while the landing she came for is still loading.
fix: Translate only the active screen plus header/menu (walk .screen.active, re-run from goTo) instead of the whole document, and serve hand-checked per-language dictionaries as one cacheable static file instead of posting the page's live text on first visit.
impact: On weak 3G her draft or advert competes with ~32 POSTs and 32 full-page repaints, and the page changes language piece by piece.

title: Landing from Quick's key link, the hub is loaded twice, so the purple 'here is your advert' ring and the 'Publish my advert' label disappear a moment after they appear.
fix: In the signin branch skip the first loadLiveDash/renderDash call and just goTo('dashboard'); have msLandDraft's decoration run from goTo's own loadLiveDash().then() callback instead of racing it.
impact: The pointer to her advert flickers away and the hub arrives later than it needs to.

title: If a visitor has made a category her home screen, links that open a specific screen (seller invite links, the ?plans=1 link) are replaced by that category page a split second later, and the category page says 'Be the first to list' on every start.
fix: Skip the automatic category-home redirect when any deep-link parameter was present or the active screen is no longer 'home', and refresh openCatHome's counts after loadLiveListings completes.
impact: An invited seller or someone following a plans link lands on the wrong screen, and the category page wrongly suggests there are no adverts.

title: An invite link whose name, email or city contains a percent sign (e.g. '100% Clean') stops the app from starting: no adverts load and the invite never opens.
fix: Drop the redundant decodeURIComponent calls (URLSearchParams already decodes), or wrap each one in its own try/catch that falls back to the raw value.
impact: Rare, but that invited seller sees a blank marketplace and cannot start from her link.

title: Some advert-page wording is garbled or aimed at the wrong person: 'AI EXAMPLE GENERATED ADVERT', 'Ignored within 48hrs', and the seller's scoring rule 'Respond within 24hrs → Trust Score +3' shown in the buyer's steps.
fix: Use 'AI EXAMPLE ADVERT' (or 'AI-GENERATED EXAMPLE ADVERT'), 'Not answered within 48 hrs → …', and replace the +3 line with 'The seller is expected to reply within 48 hrs'.
impact: Reads like a translation slip and leaves buyers unsure who has to respond.

title: After a Tuppence purchase, any refusal from the payment check is shown as 'Payment not completed — nothing was charged', including the case where the card was charged but the amount check failed.
fix: Read d.detail from the verify response: show 'nothing was charged' only for the literal 'Payment verification failed' detail; for any other 400 say 'We received a payment we could not match — contact support with reference <ref>'.
impact: Rare, but then she has paid, received nothing, and is told nothing was charged.

title: A buyer can make code run inside a seller's own Seller Hub (with the seller's sign-in) just by typing HTML as their name on an introduction request.
fix: Escape at the sinks: `🙋 ${_lmEsc(intro.name)}`, `"${_lmEsc(intro.msg)}"`, and addTx('Intro accepted · '+_lmEsc(intro.name), _lmEsc(dl.title), ...). Server: buyer_name=_plain_text(intro.buyer_name)[:80] in create_intro and add 'buyer_name','buyer_first_name' to security_gate._TEXT_KEYS.
impact: Any signed-in buyer with 1T (held, refunded on decline) can act as any ID-verified seller the moment she opens her hub.

title: A car advert made in Quick can never go live: TrustSquare demands a 'confirm your vehicle details' step that it never shows her.
fix: In dashPublish seed the full row: sobState.drafts=[Object.assign({}, _r, {id:listingId, listing_status:'draft'})] so sobRenderAttest shows the Details card; and treat a 409 from dashPublish like the EULA 403 (hand over to seller-onboard phase 3 with the full row).
impact: Every Quick car seller is stuck with an advert that can never be published and no way forward.

title: Any seller can make code run in every buyer's browser by putting a double quote in an advert title (or photo address) — it breaks out of the photo tag on the advert page.
fix: Escape both: src="${_lmEsc(pd.url)}" alt="${_lmEsc(l.title)}" (and the other attribute sinks in openDetail/renderGrid); server-side also strip '"' from photo URLs in the description prefix.
impact: Stored cross-user script injection against every buyer who opens the advert.

title: The green 'Share to Status' button on every live advert in the Seller Hub does nothing, and the 'Put it on my WhatsApp Status' button on the 'You're live' screen never appears.
fix: Use ${JSON.stringify(String(dl.title||'')).replace(/"/g,'"')} (or pass only the id and read the title from dashState); in _sobGoLiveInner add `const sb=document.getElementById('sob-share-status-btn'); if(sb) sb.style.display='block';` next to the view button.
impact: The Status-card supply loop (STATUS-CARD-1) cannot be used from anywhere in the app.

title: A buyer who is not signed in (or has no Tuppence) fills in the introduction form, taps Submit, and the form closes and wipes her message before the server refuses it.
fix: In openModal, if !_msSignedEmail() route to sign-in first (keep the listing id in sessionStorage); in submitIntro keep the modal open and the fields filled until r.ok, and on 402 call topUpShort(1) without clearing; reword to '1T is held when you send it and only spent if the seller accepts' in the user's currency.
impact: The main buyer action fails for every signed-out visitor and loses what she wrote.

title: A seller who opens the invite link TrustSquare staff prepared for her (drafts already made) sees 'Could not load your listing — please check your connection' and cannot continue.
fix: In sobInit, on res.status===401 show sobAskInboxCode(sobState.email) (or the sign-in code box) and re-run the /listings/mine fetch after verify; never say 'check your connection' for a 401.
impact: Admin-assisted onboarding (founding sellers) is blocked with a misleading network error.

title: Editing an advert before accepting the Terms (every Quick first-timer, and every seller asked to re-accept) shows the short Local Market rules, and tapping 'I accept' records acceptance of the full Seller Terms she never saw.
fix: Replace the LM-modal branch with the real gate: seed the listing and goTo('seller-onboard') (phase 3 renders _EULA_HTML with the scroll/tick gate and the change note), then return to the edit; never POST /users/{email}/eula from #fea-lm-eula-modal.
impact: Consent to the Seller Terms is recorded against text the seller was never shown, bypassing the scroll-and-tick gate.

title: Tapping Publish in the Seller Hub shows 'Listing is live ✓' but the advert card keeps saying 'Draft — not visible yet' (and loses its Share/Pause buttons) until she leaves and comes back.
fix: In dashPublish: if(dl){ dl.status='active'; dl.listing_status='live'; if(dl._raw) dl._raw.listing_status='live'; } and replace the bare call with loadLiveDash().then(renderDash).
impact: Returning sellers (Terms already accepted) are told their advert is live and shown it is not.

title: A seller who listed through Quick with the WhatsApp private link (the default for Services) can accept an introduction and the buyer's 1T is spent, but neither side ever receives the other's messages, while the hub says the buyer's contact was revealed.
fix: Store relayed messages for key identities and show them as a thread on the hub card (or show the buyer's relay reply form there); until then, release the hold instead of burning it when the seller is a key identity without a phone, and change the toast to say where the conversation continues.
impact: Buyer pays for an introduction that can never reach the seller; the seller cannot contact the buyer.

title: Editing a Services advert made in Quick shows 'Service type: — select —' (her trade isn't in the list) and asks a home cleaner for call-out fees and trade registration.
fix: Endorsed: in renderEditForm's select branch, if val is non-empty and absent from f.options, prepend `<option value="${esc(val)}" selected>${esc(val)}</option>` so her actual answer is shown and preserved on save. The quick.html service_class fix is unnecessary — it is already role-class-driven, not hardcoded to 'Technical'.
impact: The app re-asks what Quick already knows (the 23 Sep Q2 complaint) and nudges her to overwrite her trade with a coarser category.

title: If an advert title or area contains a double quote (for example 55" TV or 17" rims), the Edit screen cuts it at the quote and Save writes the cut version back.
fix: Escape every interpolated value with an HTML-attribute-safe helper (e.g. _lmEsc) in both renderEditForm and renderCVEditForm's templates.
impact: Silent loss of part of the title/profile the next time the seller saves anything.

title: On the Edit screen, the description box of any advert with photos starts with a long block of photo web addresses.
fix: In _elFieldVal, strip the prefix for the desc field: `desc: desc.replace(/^\[photos:[^\]]*\]\n?/, '')`, relying on the existing server-side re-attach.
impact: Sellers see what looks like garbage in their advert text and may think it is broken.

title: After a buyer sends an introduction request (1T is held straight away) or runs a paid price/yield check, the Tuppence number in the app does not change until the page is reloaded.
fix: After a successful intro send, do `tuppence=Math.max(0,tuppence-1); updateTuppenceUI();`; in the AI price/yield checks, when d.tuppence_remaining is a number, set `tuppence=d.tuppence_remaining` and call updateTuppenceUI().
impact: A buyer who sees 1T left tries a second request and is refused with 'not enough Tuppence'.

title: When 'Go live' fails, the real reason is replaced by 'Publish failed — see error above', and there is nothing above it.
fix: Capture the last per-draft error message in a variable inside the catch and use it in the final reason ('Publish failed — '+lastErr), or only fall back to the generic string when errEl is still empty.
impact: The seller cannot tell why her advert did not publish or what to fix.

title: On 'Edit profile', anything the seller starts typing (and any tag she adds) is wiped a second or two later when her saved profile arrives from the server.
fix: Either show a brief 'Loading…' and fetch before the first render, or in the .then() callback only fill editingSeller fields that are still empty/untouched instead of unconditionally overwriting and fully re-rendering.
impact: Lost input on slow connections, where the fetch takes longest.

title: 'Use a different account' → 'Continue — Start Listing' does nothing on the live site, yet it has already switched the saved account to the unverified email she typed.
fix: Guard like saveCVEdit does (`if(!SELLERS[0]) SELLERS[0]={};`) before the Object.assign, and don't commit the new ms_aa_email until it's proven — call /auth/logout then requestSignInLink instead of writing it immediately.
impact: Account switching is a dead button that leaves the app showing one identity and acting as another.

title: The 'You're live' screen tells every new seller that banking details are 'Required' and offers 'Add banking details →', but there is no banking form anywhere in the app.
fix: Hide the nudge (and the matching tip at saveEditedListing line 11640) until an actual banking-details form exists that posts to POST /users/{email}/banking.
impact: A dead end at the seller's best moment, with a 'Required' claim she cannot satisfy.

title: The old 'Unfinished listing → Resume' route on the hub leads to a publish screen that says 'is live on TrustSquare' while the advert is actually saved as a hidden draft (or fails after creating one).
fix: Remove the sell-b resume banner (or route 'Resume' into the sell-flow instead); if sell-b is kept, publish via PUT /listings/{id}/publish after creation instead of relying on the ignored listing_status:'live', and decode photos with atob like handleCVPhoto does instead of fetch(dataUrl).
impact: A seller following an old resume prompt gets a false 'live' message or duplicate invisible drafts.

title: A crafted invite link can inject page code into the 'Create your seller account' screen through the name in the link.
fix: Escape it: `Welcome, ${_lmEsc(magicLink.name)}!` — and treat any other unescaped innerHTML interpolation of URL-derived values the same way.
impact: Low-likelihood reflected script injection that needs the victim to take a specific extra step.

title: Changing the profile photo always says '✓ Photo uploaded' even when the upload to the account was refused or failed.
fix: Track the upload result in a variable and show 'Saved on this phone only — sign in to save it to your account' when !up.ok or the request throws.
impact: The seller believes her photo is saved to her account when it only lives on this phone.

title: The 'Keep live' button gives no feedback when it fails, so it looks dead.
fix: Replace both console.warn calls with showToast('Could not keep it live: '+ (e && e.message) +' — sign in and try again.').
impact: A seller trying to stop her advert disappearing cannot tell it didn't work.

title: Publishing from the hub on a full free plan only shows a toast saying 'Choose a bigger plan', with no button to do it.
fix: On res.status===402 in dashPublish, call openPlans('dashboard', true) after the toast, matching the pattern already used in sbDoPublish.
impact: A seller with two live adverts has no route from the hub to publish her third (e.g. a new Quick draft).

title: While the 'One last check — enter the 6-digit code' box is open, the 'Go live' button stays active, and tapping it again silently mails a new code that makes the first one stop working.
fix: Keep #sob-p3-next disabled (or hide it) while #sob-proof-box exists, and have a second sobGoLive tap focus the existing code box instead of re-sending.
impact: A new seller who taps twice gets two emails and a confusing rejection of the first code.

title: Saving any change to a Quick-made car, collectable or Local Market advert in the app replaces its price with a nonsense number (for example 'R1 000–R5 000' becomes R10,005,000).
fix: Only send price when the box actually changed (compare with the value it was filled with) and fill the box with raw.price as stored; for non-rate categories send a typed price as typed instead of stripping it to digits.
impact: After a seller only fixes a typo, buyers see R150,300 instead of R150k–R300k or R10 million for a R1k–R5k collectable, while the description still shows the old range.

title: A seller can put code in a Local Market price that runs in the browser of every buyer who opens Local Market in that city.
fix: Make formatZAR return _wlEsc(s) on its pass-through branch and escape every `|| l.price` / `String(l.price)` / l.per fallback; server-side add 'price' to CONTENT-GATE-1 _TEXT_KEYS (or _plain_text the price in create, update and LM create).
impact: Script runs inside the visiting buyer's signed-in session and can act on their account.

title: Choosing 'Local Market' in the app's Sell wizard can never publish: every 'I accept' on the terms just reopens the same terms box.
fix: Add {headers:{'X-Api-Key':API_KEY}} to the fetch in _feaLmCheckEula, and in the pending continuation skip the re-check when the /local-market/eula/accept POST returned ok.
impact: Sellers who pick Local Market in the app are stuck in a loop and their item never goes live (only Quick's Local Market door works).

title: Anyone with an account can put themselves on your Buzz list, and a display name containing code runs it when you open Buzz.
fix: Escape other_name/other_email with _wlEsc in buzzRender; _plain_text the name in POST /users and in quick-publish key identities; list a pair to the other person only once they have engaged (or require the connecting link/reference), and correct the empty-state sentence.
impact: A stranger who knows a seller's email can run script in her signed-in session the moment she opens Buzz, and the screen's safety promise is false.

title: Every advert made with '✨ List with AI Coach' is filed under Pretoria, whatever city the seller is in.
fix: fd.append('city', (activeCity && activeCity.name) || localStorage.getItem('ms_user_city') || ''), plus country/geo_city_id; make aa_publish resolve geo_city_id and country like create_listing instead of defaulting to Pretoria.
impact: A Johannesburg or Cape Town seller's advert is invisible to local buyers (it shows in Pretoria) and she cannot fix it in the app.

title: If a seller ran the AI Coach, her private Trust Score to-do list is printed at the bottom of her public advert.
fix: Send coach_output as '' from aaDoPublish (13769), or have aa_publish keep it in a private column rather than the description.
impact: Buyers read lines like 'AI coaching notes: 1. Upload your PPRA registration (+15 pts)', which advertises what credentials the seller lacks.

title: The Listing Coach throws away many of the seller's answers: a Property advert loses bedrooms, bathrooms, garages, property type, sale-or-rent and sizes; Adventures lose their price; collectables lose condition and catalogue details.
fix: In aa_publish write beds/baths/garages/prop_type/listing_type/floor_area/erf_size (and subject/level/mode) into their columns; map price_per_night → price 'R… / night' and price_per_person → 'R… / person'; add the remaining ids (condition, catalogue_ref, edition_year, destination, duration, group_size, difficulty, accommodation_type, sleeps, amenities, registered, callout_fee, days_available, references, parking_type) to field_labels.
impact: Adverts go live without the details buyers filter on (a rental with no beds or sale/rent, a lodge with no price), and the E2E 'Coach answers read back' fix finds nothing for Registered and Call-out fee.

title: Editing an advert shows many details blank and silently discards changes to them while saying 'changes are live' (cars' make, model, year and mileage; Adventures' price; services' travel radius, experience, registration and call-out fee; collectables' condition).
fix: Map the vehicle ids to their columns in _elFieldVal and the payload (year↔vehicle_year, mileage↔mileage_km, make/model/variant/colour/transmission/fuel_type/body_type); for header-only fields rewrite their '**Label:** …' line in payload.description the way the Rate line is rewritten; send Adventures price_per_* as price with its basis.
impact: Sellers retype 'missing' details, tap Save, see '✓ Listing updated — changes are live', and nothing changed.

title: After publishing one advert with the Listing Coach, the Publish button for the next advert stays greyed out saying 'Publishing…' until the app is reloaded.
fix: Reset the button on success (btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Publish Listing') or at the start of aaRenderPublishScreen.
impact: Agents and sellers listing several items in one sitting hit a dead Publish button with no explanation.

title: In the Listing Coach, 'Save Draft' saves nothing — it returns to the draft list and everything typed on the details page is lost (tapping the category chip again also clears the form).
fix: Make Save Draft collect and store the fields the way aaSaveDetailAndNext does (without the headline check or the jump to Photos) before goTo('aa-home'); in aaSelectCategory keep the saved/current values when the category is unchanged.
impact: A seller who taps Save Draft to finish later comes back to an 'Untitled · No category' draft and must start again.

title: In the Listing Coach, 'Get AI Suggestions' on a car or adventure shows '[object Object]' for a new draft, and on a saved draft it coaches (and charges for) the old answers and then wipes what is on screen.
fix: Use `AA_CATEGORIES[category]?.serviceClasses ? (draft.service_class||null) : null` (matching the generic pattern already used in aaSaveDetailAndNext, lines 13197-13200), send `category` (the resolved local variable) rather than draft.category, and render server error details defensively (`typeof detail==='string'?detail:'Please check the form'`).
impact: Car and trip sellers get a garbage error, or pay for advice on outdated answers and lose their latest typing.

title: On the Edit Listing screen, tapping '💬 Ask AI Coach' (1T) throws away every change typed since the screen opened.
fix: Render from a shallow copy of elCurrentRaw overlaid with the just-collected values (desc→description, rate→price, etc.), or inject the suggestion pills into the existing DOM without rebuilding the input elements.
impact: A seller who edits her description and then asks the coach for help loses the edit and has paid 1T.

title: Tapping 'Continue' on a Listing Coach draft that was already published opens the Publish screen, and publishing again creates a second copy of the advert.
fix: In both aaOpenDraft and aaDoPublish, when draft.listing_id is already set, route to the dashboard or openEditListing(draft.listing_id) with an 'Already published' message instead of re-running the publish screen.
impact: Duplicate adverts use up the seller's slots (2 on the free plan) and confuse buyers.

title: Local Market buyers are told 'Request Introduction · 1T on acceptance', but Local Market is free for buyers (the next screen says 'free for buyers'), and the Sell wizard tells sellers the buyer pays.
fix: Change both CTAs to 'Request Introduction · free for buyers' and the tile to 'Seller pays 1T on the first introduction'.
impact: Buyers with no Tuppence may not ask for an introduction they could make for free, and sellers misjudge who pays.

title: The Local Market tile on the home page counts (and shows photos of) items from every city and downloads all of those photos at start-up, but tapping it shows only your city.
fix: Add `&city=`+encodeURIComponent(activeCity.name) to the home-tile fetch and only preload the next photo lazily inside showNext instead of all of them up front.
impact: The tile promises items the page never shows, and phones on weak data spend bandwidth on up to 50 photos at launch.

title: Tapping ♡ on a Local Market item blanks the whole list to 'Loading…' and jumps back to the top, and the saved item never appears under Saved.
fix: Toggle the heart button's class/fill in place instead of calling lmLoadGrid(); surface lm_ items in Saved by fetching /local-market/listings/{id} for each saved lm_ key, or hide the heart on Local Market cards until that exists.
impact: Every save disrupts browsing a long list, and 'saved' items cannot be found again.

title: The Local Market create route publishes straight away with none of the platform's guards: no Terms acceptance, no phone/e-mail scrub, no daily limit and no plan slot limit.
fix: In lm_create_listing, run title/description through _plain_text + _private_text_scrub before insert, call launch_redemption.check_listing_velocity(seller_email), and refuse (or force a draft/held state) when the seller has no recorded eula_accepted_at, matching every sibling listing-creation route.
impact: A seller can publish 'phone me on 082…' in a Local Market advert and bypass the introduction model; fixing the app loop (Local Market Sell wizard) exposes this to everyone.

title: The Billing tab offers 'Upgrade →' to the free Agency plan and then refuses, tells Agency members that Pro is a 'Downgrade' before sending them to pay, and labels real agents 'admin test account … (dev override)'.
fix: Render the Agency card with an 'Apply' link instead of Upgrade/Downgrade; decide Upgrade vs Downgrade from the tier's actual price rather than array position; show the dev-override sentence only when isSuperuser() is true.
impact: Subscription choices are mislabelled around real money, and paying agents see a debug label.

title: The Listing Coach writes every rate in Rand and glues the unit on ('R450once-off / fixed'), so sellers outside South Africa are published with Rand rates and a fixed-price service reads 'per fixed'.
fix: Use aaCurrency().symbol with an explicit separator (`${sym}${amt} ${unit}`) in both call sites, and rename the 'once-off / fixed' unit label to something that survives the split('/').pop() price-suffix logic, e.g. 'once-off (fixed)'.
impact: A London tutor's rate is published as 'R30/hr', and a fixed-price trade shows 'R450 per fixed'.

title: A Trust Score declaration shows '✅ Submitted.' even when the server refused it or the connection failed.
fix: Add `if(!res){ statusEl.textContent='⚠️ Could not submit — please try again.'; return; }` before the points_awarded/already_declared branches.
impact: Sellers believe they earned points they did not.

title: The Yield Calc panel keeps saying '📈 Calculating yield…' after you cancel the figure prompt or the calculation is refused.
fix: Clear out.innerHTML (or set an explicit 'not charged' message) at the top of each of these early-return branches instead of leaving the calculating text in place.
impact: Sellers wait on a calculation that is not happening.

title: Local Market screens and the Sell flow show stray backslashes, e.g. 'The buyer\'s current Trust Score' and 'I\'ll remind you if anything's missing'.
fix: Replace \' with ' on those five lines.
impact: Visible typos on the Terms and sell screens make the app look unfinished.

title: Saving any change to a Services or Tutors advert rewrites the first 'rate:' phrase in the seller's own words (e.g. 'Hourly rate: negotiable for groups' becomes 'Hourly rate: R300 / hour'), and a rate with cents breaks Quick's sentence.
fix: Only rewrite the description when the price actually changed, and anchor the match to a full sentence rather than stopping at the first period, e.g. `/(^|[.!?]\s+)(Rate:\s*)[^\n]*?(?=\.(\s|$)|\n|$)/`.
impact: Sellers' descriptions change without them noticing.

title: The Local Market create form accepts 'up to 5' photos but uploads only the first, says nothing if that photo is refused, forces the seller's account country to South Africa, and after success leaves her on the category step.
fix: Upload each of up to 5 selected files and send photo_urls; surface the server's rejection reason when a photo POST fails; send the seller's real activeCountry.iso2 instead of a never-written localStorage key; after success, goTo('dashboard') or open the new listing directly instead of showPhase('claim').
impact: Photos silently go missing, a non-South-African seller's account is relabelled ZA, and there is no path to the new advert.

title: The Listing Coach 'How it works' sheet says Tutors need 2 required photos (only 1 is required), calls every AI Coach run 'free' (only the first is), and says a published advert 'goes live as a pending draft'.
fix: Correct the three strings.
impact: Sellers are told the wrong requirements and costs.

title: When a profile photo is refused, My Space just says 'Photo upload failed' and hides the server's reason (for example an unsupported format).
fix: showToast('Photo upload failed: '+err.message, 5000) in the catch block.
impact: Sellers cannot tell what to change and give up.

title: Buyers cannot ask for an introduction to any seller who has not paid for the optional Home Affairs check: the button says introductions are closed and the request is never sent, even when the seller's ID is verified and the server would accept it.
fix: Add seller_can_receive = (_seller_intro_gate(conn, seller_email) is None) to the GET /listings/{id} payload and gate openModal/_msSellerCanReceive/msUnverifiedGate on it; keep seller_id_green_tick only for the badge. Delete the now-unused msg string in msUnverifiedGate.
impact: The core paid action of the marketplace is dead for every seller without a Home Affairs tick - very likely all of them while that lane is parked.

title: If the connection drops (or the server says no) at 'Publish now' or 'Save draft & finish later', the seller is told her draft is saved or that nothing was lost, but nothing was saved, and she is moved to a screen saying she has no draft.
fix: Have goHandoff return ok/false; when goState.listingId is null, stay on the scorecard (no goTo), keep sfState, show the error with a Retry button that calls sfFinish again, and only toast 'Draft saved' after a real id.
impact: On patchy mobile data the whole advert - photos and every answer - is lost at the last tap while the app says it is safe.

title: Pressing the phone's Back button, pulling the page down to refresh, or anything else that reloads the page throws away every photo and answer in the sell flow, with no warning.
fix: In sfGo push history.pushState({sf:s},'') and add a popstate handler that steps back inside the flow while screen-sell-flow is active; add a beforeunload prompt when sfPhotoCount()>0 or any A/B/C field is filled; save sfState (minus File objects) to sessionStorage on sfUpd/sfGo and offer 'Continue your listing' after a reload; set overscroll-behavior-y:contain on #screen-sell-flow.
impact: Android users use Back constantly; one press loses a half-built advert of up to 24 photos.

title: Tapping the Sell button during a listing, or stepping back to the category tiles and tapping your category again, silently starts a blank listing and deletes the photos and answers already entered.
fix: In goTo only call sfInit() when no draft is in progress (otherwise sfRender() the saved screen, or ask 'Continue your listing / Start again'); in sfStartCat resume when the same category is picked and confirm before resetting for a different one; send Photos' ← to subpick/lmpick for sub-picked categories.
impact: A seller who steps back one screen, or checks the Wallet or Browse and returns via Sell, loses the whole advert.

title: A cleaner or gardener who chooses 'Per day' or 'Per job' as her rate basis is published with a price that says 'per hour'.
fix: In _sfPriceWithUnit use sfState.A.unit when set: {'Per hour':'/ hour','Per day':'/ day','Per job':'/ job'}[sfState.A.unit] || flow.priceUnit.
impact: Buyers see a day rate as an hourly rate (about eight times too high) and the advert contradicts itself.

title: Adverts made in the sell flow lose the kind the seller picked, so guest houses and experiences disappear when buyers tap 'Stays' or 'Experiences', and Services and Tutors adverts drop out of the Class and Mode filters.
fix: In sfFinish send category 'adventures_'+sfState.sub for Adventures, service_class {technical:'Technical',casual:'Casuals'}[sfState.sub] for Services, and mode from A.mode mapped to the filter words ('In person'->'In-person', 'Both'->'Either'); add service_class and mode to goHandoff's POST and PUT bodies.
impact: A B&B listed through the sell flow never shows under 'Stays', and sellers' adverts miss the filters buyers actually use.

title: An invited seller outside South Africa still has her advert filed as South African and priced in Rand, because the sell flow never tells the server her country.
fix: In sfFinish set goState.country = sfState.country, and add country: goState.country to goHandoff's POST body and PUT patch.
impact: A Montana outfitter's '$450 / person' trip is shown as 'R450' and sits in the wrong country's market.

title: 'In a hurry? 5-tap Quick advert' leaves the app with no warning, so a seller who comes back to the category screen with a half-built listing loses it, and Quick's way back opens the app's front page rather than her listing.
fix: When sfPhotoCount()>0 or any answer is filled, confirm before navigating ('Leave your listing? Your photos and answers will be lost') or hide the Quick line entirely at that point; once sell-flow drafts persist across reloads, have Quick's way back use a resume link such as /?resume=sell.
impact: Peeking at Quick from a half-finished listing costs the seller everything she has entered.

title: Every sell-flow step says 'drafts are saved' and the score screen says 'Your draft is saved', but nothing is saved until the seller taps 'Save draft & finish later'.
fix: Say 'Not saved yet — tap Save draft to keep it' until a draft id exists (or add the autosave from ts4-03 and keep the words true).
impact: Sellers trust the message, leave, and lose the listing.

title: The listing-quality number the sell flow shows is not the number TrustSquare ranks by, or the one Quick shows: a complete tutor advert shows 100 in the app but is stored as 82.
fix: Feed the sell-flow's score meter from a debounced POST /quality/preview call using the composed title/description/price/suburb/category fields (or port _import_quality_score to the client), and build the 'lift your score' advice from the server's own missing-fields list rather than a second, independent rubric.
impact: '100 — Excellent listing' and 'the advice below lifts you higher in search' do not match the score that decides her ranking, and the 50-point bar is judged on a different scale from everything else.

title: A seller below the 50-point standard who taps 'Save draft & finish later' is walked straight into the plan and 'Go live' screens and can publish the listing the app just said could not be published.
fix: For draftOnly, route to the dashboard (goTo('dashboard'); msLandDraft()) with a 'saved' note instead of into seller-onboard; if the 50-point bar is meant to be enforced, check it server-side in the publish route or in sobGoLive rather than only gating the client's button choice.
impact: The seller who chose to finish later is pushed through a publish funnel, and the 50-point rule is not a rule.

title: Two sell-flow helpers answer 'Please sign in to do that.' to anyone not signed in - the 'Ask me a question' coach on every step and the 'Introduce me — free for you' agent button - including sellers who arrived from an invitation letter.
fix: Either declare /advert-agent/coach/ask 'public' (the handler already rate-limits per session/email and checks invited-prospect status itself) or hide the ask box and agent-intro buttons when there is no session and offer a 'Sign in to ask' link instead of a wording that references a non-existent sign-in step.
impact: The free coach and the agent introduction advertised on these screens never work for new or invited sellers, who are most of the people in the sell flow.

title: 'Ask AI how to improve my score' plans for whichever category happens to be first in the marketplace feed, not the seller's own, so a gardener can be told to upload an estate agent's PPRA certificate.
fix: Derive catForCoach from the seller's own listings instead: `(dashState.listings.find(d=>d.listing_status==='live')||dashState.listings[0]||{}).cat || 'General'`.
impact: The coach's step list includes credentials for a trade the seller is not in, and misses the ones for her own.

title: When the AI photo check finishes it redraws the whole sell-flow screen even if the seller has moved on and is typing, and a late 'wrong kind of photo' answer can quietly delete the replacement cover photo she just picked.
fix: Guard both branches with `if(sfState.files.main!==file) return;` at the top (the file this particular call was reading), and skip sfRender() when the active step isn't 'photos' or an input currently has focus, reusing the _typing guard sfRunMultiVision already has.
impact: Typing is interrupted by the keyboard closing and the page jumping; in the swap case the cover photo she saw accepted is not published.

title: Sell-flow photos are handled at full camera size: each is uploaded two or three times and kept as a multi-megabyte picture that is rebuilt on every screen redraw, which is slow and costly on an entry-level phone and prepaid data.
fix: On pick, draw each image once to a canvas capped at ~1600px (JPEG quality 0.8) and keep that smaller Blob in sfState.files instead of the raw File; preview with URL.createObjectURL (revoking on removal); upload the same small Blob to all three endpoints.
impact: On weak 3G the listing takes minutes and eats data; with many photos the page can stall or crash, losing the in-memory draft.

title: In AI Features, starting a second report while the first is still running makes the first report stop the second one's progress, so the second paid report never appears and the first report keeps redrawing forever.
fix: Call clearInterval(AI_POLL) at the very start of aiRun (and aiSel/aiExample), and keep each interval's id scoped to its own job/closure (`const t=setInterval(()=>aiPoll(jobId,t),...)`, calling clearInterval(t) from inside itself) so cancelling one job's poll can never touch another's.
impact: A report costing Tuppence is run but never shown, and the screen keeps flashing the old one.

title: Every tap on Home downloads the whole heritage-site list again (about 600 KB) and redraws every heritage card, even though the new copy is almost always thrown away.
fix: Fetch /wonders once per session (skip the refresh entirely once _wpAllWonders.length>0, rather than merely de-duplicating concurrent calls); server-side, delete the shadowed first _load_wonders and add caching to the one that's actually in effect (or just delete the duplicate and cache the remaining definition).
impact: Wasted mobile data and a heavy redraw on the most-visited screen.

title: With the language layer on, advert titles on the browse cards are still machine-translated even though the language menu says adverts stay in the seller's language, so one advert reads differently on its card and on its own page.
fix: Add data-notranslate to .ctitle (and the saved/history title lines) when msLangOn(), matching the detail page.
impact: Buyers see a machine version on the card and the seller's own words after tapping.

title: In isiZulu or Afrikaans the sell flow stays partly English: the email question at publish, every dropdown choice, every example text, the long legal-step explanation - and the quality meter flips back to English on every keystroke.
fix: Give options explicit value= and let their text translate; translate placeholders through a data attribute pass; split long text into sentences before asking; replace the prompt() with an in-page email field; update the meter's number and bar in place instead of replacing the node.
impact: A non-English seller meets English exactly where care matters: the legal note, her email and the choices she must pick.

title: A reader who picked Sepedi in Quick opens the app in Sepedi, but the app's language button says 'English' and its menu has no Sepedi entry while the language layer is switched off.
fix: In pill(), when lang is not in LANGS, add [lang, (LC&&LC.names[lang])||'Sepedi'/msLangCode(lang)] to the list and label.
impact: The button misreports the language, and a reader looking for Sepedi can only switch the page back to English.

title: After a mistyped email at publish, the publish button is renamed 'List it' (and after an error 'Continue to publish 🚀') and the message says 'tap List it again', though the button said 'Publish now — I accept the Terms'.
fix: Remember the original label (var lbl=btn.textContent) and restore it; change the toast to 'tap Publish now again'.
impact: The seller is told to tap a button that does not exist, and the button that carries her acceptance of the Terms loses its wording.

title: The Services category home screen says 'electricers' instead of 'electricians'.
fix: Change 'electricers' to 'electricians'.
impact: A visible spelling mistake on a category's home screen.

title: My Space shows a made-up ranking ('Top 60% of members' for a score of 40) and names the trust levels differently from the rest of the app.
fix: Remove the invented percentile line (or compute it server-side from the real score distribution) and reuse the existing 40/70/90 trustTier labels instead of a second, differently-cut naming scheme.
impact: Sellers are shown an invented statistic and two different names for the same score.

title: An AI report can contain a link that runs script in the reader's browser, because the report renderer does not escape quotes inside link addresses.
fix: Escape " and ' in aiEsc, and in aiInline accept only URLs matching a strict pattern such as `^https?://[^\s"'<>]+$`.
impact: A poisoned web source could run code in a paying user's session while she reads her report.

title: After an agent accepts a seller lead (1 Tuppence charged) the wallet badge keeps showing the old balance until the app is reloaded.
fix: Subtract the charge locally before repainting (`tuppence=Math.max(0,tuppence-1); updateTuppenceUI();`), or re-read GET /tuppence/balance before calling updateTuppenceUI(), matching the pattern already used in sqTopup.
impact: The agent sees 1T more than the ledger holds.

title: Every Quick visit downloads six US trip pictures that do not exist on the server (404), even for a visitor in South Africa.
fix: Only preload the pictures of her own country pack, and add or remove the six missing dest_us_* files.
impact: Wasted data and broken pictures for US trips.

title: The "Your advert is saved" card is see-through, so the advert, the E-mail/WhatsApp tabs and "Saving…" show through behind its buttons.
fix: Give the saved-card overlay an opaque background (or blur the page behind it).
impact: The most important screen in Quick looks broken and is hard to read.

title: The saved card says "Your advert is saved." twice, and the server sentence under it uses "--" instead of a dash.
fix: Drop the duplicate heading line and write the server messages with an em dash.
impact: Looks unfinished.

title: Quick picks her country from her internet address only, so anyone on a data-saving browser or VPN routed abroad is shown another country's cities with no way to change country.
fix: Add a small "Not in <country>? Change" link on the city step, like the existing "Not in Pretoria? Change city".
impact: Some real South African users cannot list in their own city.

title: Quick's first screen now weighs 1.07 MB in 41 requests (427 KB this morning): 4.0 s to show on 4G and 7.2 s on weak 3G.
